_comment: Copy this file to onshape_credentials.json (gitignored) and fill in your own Onshape API key pair + the target document/workspace/element ids. Create a key pair at https://dev-portal.onshape.com. The target element must be a STEP blob element. You can also supply any of these via env vars: ONSHAPE_ACCESS_KEY, ONSHAPE_SECRET_KEY, ONSHAPE_DOCUMENT_ID, ONSHAPE_WORKSPACE_ID, ONSHAPE_ELEMENT_ID (env wins over the file). If neither is configured, `py -3.12 -m src.build` simply skips the push.
